method: Review the complete eleven-file PACKAGE_VALIDATED research record against its contract, verify source→claim provenance completeness, preserve research conclusions, and keep all product/import/publication/deploy authorities false.

independentVerification.detail: The package keeps core OKX Poland service posture limited rather than blanket available and separates Poland-specific launch/permitted-country evidence from generic EEA context.
KNF payment-services notification and investment-firm notification are retained as separate entity/regime evidence and are not promoted into a generic Poland crypto licence claim.
PLN P2P and EUR SEPA evidence remain separate; direct PLN bank rail remains not verified.
Investment-product posture remains conditional and does not derive account-level access from the KNF notification alone.
EEA referral-program existence remains separate from exact Poland eligibility for CBW's global OKX URL/code and from any fixed current Poland reward claim.

correctionsRequired.finding: All 17 source records are compact and omit contract-required provenance metadata beyond sourceId/url/support relationships.
correctionsRequired.requiredChange: In the corrected package restore for all 17 sources title, publisher, publication/update/checked dates, language, source tier/family, official-source status, confidence, verification status/method, limitations, exact supports/contradicts relationships and notes. Preserve every sourceId, URL and substantive evidence relationship.

correctionsRequired.finding: All 20 claim records omit contract-required primary-evidence provenance metadata even though claim/source IDs and verdicts are present.
correctionsRequired.requiredChange: In the corrected package restore for all 20 claims primary evidence URL/publisher/title/dates/language/source tier/confidence/limitations and exact supported/contradicted source relationships. Preserve every claimId, verdict, confidence, source relationship and factual/product conclusion.

correctionScope: Exactly CORR-001 and CORR-002. No source URL, research conclusion, verdict, product/rail posture, referral posture, import readiness or authorization flag may be upgraded or otherwise changed except mechanically to restore missing provenance metadata.
